project.title: 狗子的戏剧人生
project.premise: 一只狗在奇幻世界的戏剧性冒险故事

burden_type.question: Every Crucible story has an external burden—something carried toward destruction or completion. What form does this burden take?
burden_type.description: An artifact that must be destroyed or protected

fire_type.question: The Fire is your protagonist's internal power that threatens to consume them. What is its nature?
fire_type.description: Becoming something other than a normal dog - gaining human-like intelligence or magical abilities

core_bond.question: Which bond will be the protagonist's anchor—the one that CANNOT break?
core_bond.description: A battle-companion or childhood friend who stands by them

dark_mirror.question: What connects protagonist and antagonist as dark mirrors?
dark_mirror.answer: One is what the other could become
dark_mirror.description: The antagonist shows what the protagonist could become if they lose their way

forging_question.question: What must your protagonist BECOME to complete their quest?
forging_question.answer: Someone who can trust despite betrayal
forging_question.description: A character who maintains faith in others even after being hurt

antagonist_truth.question: What truth does your antagonist see that others deny?
antagonist_truth.description: The antagonist believes that emotional attachments are weaknesses to be eliminated

surrender.question: At the Apex, what essential thing must the protagonist willingly surrender?
surrender.description: Must give up the magical transformation or abilities they've gained

theme.question: What is the moral argument of your story?
theme.answer: Love is a vulnerability that becomes strength
theme.description: Emotional attachments make you vulnerable but ultimately give you the power to prevail

blades_purpose.question: After the forging, what does the protagonist become?
blades_purpose.answer: A healer using their wound to help others
blades_purpose.description: Someone who uses their experiences to heal and protect others

burden_origin.question: What is the origin of the burden in your story?
burden_origin.description: An object of power from an ancient civilization that has resurfaced

why_protagonist.question: Why must THIS protagonist carry this burden?
why_protagonist.description: The protagonist stumbled upon the burden by chance/accident

antagonist_stake.question: What is the antagonist's stake in this quest?
antagonist_stake.description: The antagonist seeks the burden to increase their own power

quest_escalation.question: How does the quest escalate throughout the story?
quest_escalation.description: What starts as a personal mission becomes a world-saving quest

impossible_requirement.question: What makes completing the quest seemingly impossible?
impossible_requirement.description: The antagonist's forces seem too powerful to overcome

resolution_method.question: How is the quest ultimately resolved?
resolution_method.description: The protagonist must sacrifice something essential to succeed

manifestation.question: How does the Fire manifest in the protagonist?
manifestation.description: Developing powers that grow stronger with use but are dangerous

danger.question: What is the danger of the Fire?
danger.description: Using the power makes the protagonist lose their essential self

cost.question: What does using the Fire cost?
cost.description: Each use damages the ability to feel emotions or form bonds

mastery_path.question: What is the path to mastering the Fire?
mastery_path.description: The protagonist must accept both the power and its cost

hardening.question: How does the protagonist harden to the Fire?
hardening.description: Through necessity, the protagonist uses the Fire repeatedly and begins to change

mastery_moment.question: What is the moment of mastery?
mastery_moment.description: The protagonist chooses to surrender the Fire rather than be consumed by it

companion.question: Who is the faithful companion?
companion.description: Someone who has known the protagonist before their transformation

sacrifice_character.question: Who is the sacrifice character?
sacrifice_character.description: The faithful companion must make a significant sacrifice

betrayal_source.question: Where does the betrayal come from?
betrayal_source.description: What appears to be betrayal is actually a necessary sacrifice

expansion.question: How does the constellation expand?
expansion.description: Former enemies or neutral characters join the protagonist's circle

saving_bond.question: Which bond saves the protagonist?
saving_bond.description: The primary relationship that has been tested throughout

fate.question: What is the fate of the constellation?
fate.description: The relationships are forever changed by the journey

quest_crisis.question: FP0 Ignition - What Quest crisis emerges?
quest_crisis.description: The protagonist discovers the burden and cannot ignore it

fire_crisis.question: FP0 Ignition - What Fire crisis emerges?
fire_crisis.description: The protagonist first experiences the transformation

constellation_crisis.question: FP0 Ignition - What Constellation crisis emerges?
constellation_crisis.description: The protagonist forms their core relationship

sacrifice.question: FP0 Ignition - What is sacrificed?
sacrifice.description: The protagonist gives up their ordinary existence

quest_crisis.question: FP1 First Crucible - What Quest crisis emerges?
quest_crisis.description: The protagonist faces the antagonist's forces directly

fire_crisis.question: FP1 First Crucible - What Fire crisis emerges?
fire_crisis.description: The protagonist must use the power in a significant way

constellation_crisis.question: FP1 First Crucible - What Constellation crisis emerges?
constellation_crisis.description: The core bond is tested for the first time

sacrifice.question: FP1 First Crucible - What is sacrificed?

quest_crisis.question: FP2 Second Crucible - What Quest crisis emerges?
quest_crisis.description: The antagonist gains a significant advantage

fire_crisis.question: FP2 Second Crucible - What Fire crisis emerges?
fire_crisis.description: The protagonist becomes more dependent on the power

constellation_crisis.question: FP2 Second Crucible - What Constellation crisis emerges?

sacrifice.question: FP2 Second Crucible - What is sacrificed?
sacrifice.description: The protagonist's ability to trust is damaged

quest_crisis.question: FP3 Third Crucible - What Quest crisis emerges?
quest_crisis.description: The protagonist reaches their lowest point

fire_crisis.question: FP3 Third Crucible - What Fire crisis emerges?
fire_crisis.description: The protagonist nearly loses themselves to the power

constellation_crisis.question: FP3 Third Crucible - What Constellation crisis emerges?
constellation_crisis.description: The protagonist is separated from all allies

sacrifice.question: FP3 Third Crucible - What is sacrificed?
sacrifice.description: The protagonist nearly gives up entirely

quest_crisis.question: Apex - What Quest crisis emerges?
quest_crisis.description: The protagonist faces the antagonist for the last time

fire_crisis.question: Apex - What Fire crisis emerges?
fire_crisis.description: The protagonist must choose to give up the power

constellation_crisis.question: Apex - What Constellation crisis emerges?
constellation_crisis.description: The core relationship saves the protagonist

sacrifice.question: Apex - What is sacrificed?
sacrifice.description: The protagonist surrenders the Fire to succeed

origin_parallel.question: What origin parallel does the antagonist share with the protagonist?
origin_parallel.description: Both gained power through similar means

divergence.question: Where did their paths diverge?
divergence.description: The antagonist embraced the power's cost while the protagonist resisted

want.question: What does the antagonist want?
want.description: To dominate and control others using their power

offer.question: What compelling offer does the antagonist make?
offer.description: The antagonist offers partnership and shared power

tempting_reason.question: Why is this offer tempting?
tempting_reason.description: The antagonist promises to end the struggle

hidden_cost.question: What is the hidden cost?
hidden_cost.description: Accepting means losing what makes the protagonist who they are

defeat_method.question: How is the antagonist defeated?
defeat_method.description: The protagonist rejects the antagonist's offer and path

antagonist_end.question: What is the antagonist's end?
antagonist_end.description: The antagonist either finds redemption or dies

protagonist_name.question: What is the protagonist's name?
protagonist_name.description: The central character - a dog who gains extraordinary abilities

companion_name.question: What is the faithful companion's name?
companion_name.description: A human who has known 狗子 since before the transformation

companion_role.question: What role does the companion play?
companion_role.description: They keep 狗子 connected to their humanity

mentor.question: Who is the mentor/catalyst character?
mentor.description: An experienced magic user who guides 狗子

antagonist_name.question: What is the antagonist's name?
antagonist_name.description: A dark mirror of 狗子 who embraced the power's cost

act.question: Mercy 1 - What is the merciful act?
act.description: 狗子 lets them live instead of killing

cost.question: Mercy 1 - What is the immediate cost?
cost.description: Putting 狗子 at risk later

payoff.question: Mercy 1 - What is the later payoff?
payoff.description: The spared enemy returns to help

act.question: Mercy 2 - What is the merciful act?
act.description: 狗子 protects them at personal cost

cost.question: Mercy 2 - What is the immediate cost?
cost.description: Using power to help drains 狗子

payoff.question: Mercy 2 - What is the later payoff?

act.question: Mercy 3 - What is the merciful act?
act.description: 狗子 forgives a perceived betrayal

cost.question: Mercy 3 - What is the immediate cost?

payoff.question: Mercy 3 - What is the later payoff?

act.question: Mercy 4 - What is the merciful act?
act.description: 狗子 offers 暗影 a chance to change

cost.question: Mercy 4 - What is the immediate cost?

payoff.question: Mercy 4 - What is the later payoff?
payoff.description: 暗影 either accepts or rejects, defining their end

world_wound.question: What is the wound in this world?
world_wound.description: Ancient magic has faded and needs to be restored

power_source.question: What is the source of magical power?
power_source.description: The same object 狗子 must destroy or protect

power_limits.question: What are the limitations on power?

previous_wielders.question: Who previously wielded this power?
previous_wielders.description: An advanced society that destroyed itself

key_locations.question: What are the key locations?
key_locations.description: Where the ancient power was created

world_mirror.question: How does the world mirror the protagonist?
world_mirror.description: The world's loss of magic reflects 狗子's emotional cost

magic_rules.question: What are the rules of magic?
magic_rules.description: Every use of magic exacts a toll

timeline.question: What is the timeline framework?
timeline.description: The story takes place as magic is disappearing from the world
